description:
#TheProudestBlue #IbtihajMuhammad #readaloud #kidsbookreadaloud

Have you ever seen someone wear a scarf or veil? Or do yourself wear a hijab? Today we have a really fun book about family and hijab. A young sibling witnesses her sister wearing the veil for the first time and the strength she has as she goes about her day tackling tough situations such as bullying. Let's see if we can figure out as we read together.

The Proudest Blue
by Ibtihaj Muhammed 
With S.K. Ali
Art by Hatem Aly
Publisher - Little, Brown Books for Young Readers; Illustrated edition (September 10, 2019)

Thank you so very much for watching! Don't forget to subscribe to stay up-to-date on my latest videos.

This is a hardback book which is perfect for little hands as well as older children. 

Activity ideas 
1. Create a picture book of what people get up to during Ramadan 
2. Look at the phases of the moon and the significance of the Moon in Islam 
3. Compare Ramadan and Eid - how is it similar/different? 
4. On a painted handprint, write down 5 helpful things Muslims do during Ramadan 
5. Role play waking up at Sehri/fasting all day/breaking fast - asking how do you think this feels?
